```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. INPUT & PREPROCESSING
# ==============================================================================
# Tujuan: Memuat baseline (descriptive analysis + proyeksi lahan BAU) dan
#         menyiapkan matriks lahan skenario 1 dari file Excel input.

# --- 1.1 Path File Input ------------------------------------------------------
descriptive_analysis_file        <- "inst/extdata/output/descriptive_analysis_module.rds"
# projection_area_file_bau         <- "inst/extdata/example_data/Padagimo/luc_projection_padagimo_bau_baseline.xlsx"
# projection_area_file_scenario1   <- "inst/extdata/example_data/Padagimo/luc_projection_padagimo_gbp.xlsx"
projection_area_file_bau         <- "inst/extdata/example_data/Bukecap/luc_projection_bukecap_bau.xlsx"
projection_area_file_scenario1   <- "inst/extdata/example_data/Bukecap/luc_projection_bukecap_scenario1.xlsx"

initial_year <- params$initial_year

# --- 1.2 Load Baseline --------------------------------------------------------
baseline <- load_projection_baseline(
  path = descriptive_analysis_file,
  projection_area_file_bau = projection_area_file_bau
)

# Ekstraksi komponen baseline
gdp_baseline                <- baseline$gdp_baseline
leontief_matrix             <- baseline$leontief_matrix
full_io_table               <- baseline$full_io_table
code_registry               <- baseline$code_registry
sector_idx                  <- baseline$sector_idx
intermediate_consumption.m  <- baseline$intermediate_consumption
income_multiplier           <- baseline$income_multiplier
labour_multiplier           <- baseline$labour_multiplier
SUB_multiplier              <- baseline$SUB_multiplier
output_multiplier           <- baseline$output_multiplier
linkage_table               <- baseline$linkage_table
P_default                   <- baseline$P_default
growth_rate                 <- baseline$growth_rate
area_matrix_bau             <- baseline$area_matrix_bau
constrained                 <- baseline$constrained
unconstrained               <- baseline$unconstrained

# --- 1.3 Load Skenario 1 ------------------------------------------------------
projection_area_scenario1 <- read_input_file(projection_area_file_scenario1, header = TRUE)

projection_long_scenario1 <- projection_area_scenario1 |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(ID, LC),
    names_to = "YEAR",
    values_to = "AREA"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR))

area_matrix_scenario1 <- create_area_matrix(projection_long_scenario1)

# Cek apakah ada sheet "land_proportion" di file skenario 1
sheet_names_s1 <- readxl::excel_sheets(projection_area_file_scenario1)
P_default_scenario1 <- NULL   # default: gunakan P_default baseline

if ("land_proportion" %in% sheet_names_s1) {
  cat("✓ Sheet 'land_proportion' ditemukan\n")

  df_land_prop_s1 <- readxl::read_excel(
    projection_area_file_scenario1,
    sheet = "land_proportion"
  )

  # Struktur sheet:
  #   - Baris   = sektor (61 baris)
  #   - Kolom 1 = label sektor (karakter)
  #   - Kolom 2..N = tutupan lahan (73 kolom)
  # Target P_default_scenario1: [61 sektor × 73 tutupan] — SAMA dengan P_default

  if (is.character(df_land_prop_s1[[1]]) || is.factor(df_land_prop_s1[[1]])) {
    # Kolom 1 = label sektor → keluarkan
    P_default_scenario1 <- as.matrix(df_land_prop_s1[, -1])
    rownames(P_default_scenario1) <- as.character(df_land_prop_s1[[1]])
  } else {
    # Tidak ada kolom label
    P_default_scenario1 <- as.matrix(df_land_prop_s1)
  }
  storage.mode(P_default_scenario1) <- "numeric"

  # Set colnames = nama tutupan lahan (dari header sheet)
  colnames(P_default_scenario1) <- colnames(df_land_prop_s1)[-1]

  cat("  Dimensi:", nrow(P_default_scenario1), "×",
      ncol(P_default_scenario1), "\n")

  # ⚠ Kalau ternyata hasilnya 73 × 61 (transpose), berarti orientasi sheet
  #    berbeda dari asumsi → perlu transpose
  if (nrow(P_default_scenario1) == ncol(P_default) &&
      ncol(P_default_scenario1) == nrow(P_default)) {
    cat("  ⚠ Orientasi terbalik → transpose\n")
    P_default_scenario1 <- t(P_default_scenario1)
  }
}

# --- 1.4 Index Sektor ---------------------------------------------------------
no_idx <- which(unconstrained == 1)   # sektor non-lahan (unconstrained)
co_idx <- which(constrained   == 1)   # sektor berbasis lahan (constrained)
k      <- length(no_idx)
m      <- length(co_idx)
n      <- nrow(gdp_baseline)

cat("✓ Baseline dimuat\n")
cat("  Total sektor   :", n, "\n")
cat("  Sektor co (co_idx):", m, "\n")
cat("  Sektor nc (no_idx):", k, "\n")
```

```{r skenario1-multi-indikator, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# SKENARIO 1: PROYEKSI MULTI-INDIKATOR MAKROEKONOMI & KETERKAITAN SEKTOR LAHAN
# Berbasis Supply-Constrained Mixed Input-Output Model
# Referensi: Hubacek & Sun (2001); Miller & Blair (2009, Bab 12 & 13); Ten Raa (2005)
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. SANITASI TIPE DATA UTAMA & PARAMETER BASELINE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A. Laju Pertumbuhan Permintaan Akhir (growth_rate)
growth_rate <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$growth_rate))

# --- B. Matriks Proporsi Sektor Lahan BAU (P_default) ------------------------
# P_default: [n_sektor × n_tutupan] = 61 × 73  → TIDAK perlu transpose
P_default <- as.matrix(baseline$P_default)
storage.mode(P_default) <- "numeric"

# Set nama baris = sektor (jika belum ada)
if (is.null(rownames(P_default))) {
  rownames(P_default) <- as.character(unlist(gdp_baseline$SECTOR))
}

cat("✓ P_default:", nrow(P_default), "sektor ×", ncol(P_default), "tutupan\n")

# --- C. Matriks Proporsi Sektor Lahan Skenario 1 (P_default_scenario1) -------
if (!exists("P_default_scenario1") || is.null(P_default_scenario1)) {
  cat("ℹ P_default_scenario1 tidak tersedia → gunakan P_default baseline\n")
  P_default_scenario1 <- P_default
} else {
  P_default_scenario1 <- as.matrix(P_default_scenario1)
  storage.mode(P_default_scenario1) <- "numeric"

  # Cek dimensi — kalau terbalik, transpose
  if (nrow(P_default_scenario1) != nrow(P_default) ||
      ncol(P_default_scenario1) != ncol(P_default)) {
    if (nrow(P_default_scenario1) == ncol(P_default) &&
        ncol(P_default_scenario1) == nrow(P_default)) {
      cat("⚠ P_default_scenario1 orientasi terbalik → transpose\n")
      P_default_scenario1 <- t(P_default_scenario1)
    } else {
      stop("Dimensi P_default_scenario1 tidak cocok dengan P_default")
    }
  }

  cat("✓ P_default_scenario1:", nrow(P_default_scenario1),
      "sektor ×", ncol(P_default_scenario1), "tutupan\n")
}

# --- SINKRONISASI NAMA P_default & P_default_scenario1 -----------------------
# (Letakkan TEPAT SETELAH C, SEBELUM D)
if (!is.null(P_default_scenario1)) {
  # Cek dimensi cocok
  stopifnot(nrow(P_default_scenario1) == nrow(P_default))
  stopifnot(ncol(P_default_scenario1) == ncol(P_default))

  # Samakan nama
  rownames(P_default_scenario1) <- rownames(P_default)
  colnames(P_default_scenario1) <- colnames(P_default)

  cat("✓ P_default & P_default_scenario1 sinkron:",
      nrow(P_default), "sektor ×", ncol(P_default), "tutupan\n")
}

# --- D. Matriks Luasan Tutupan Lahan BAU -------------------------------------
area_matrix_bau <- as.matrix(baseline$area_matrix_bau)
storage.mode(area_matrix_bau) <- "numeric"

# E. Matriks Luasan Tutupan Lahan Skenario 1
if (!exists("area_matrix_scenario1") || is.null(area_matrix_scenario1)) {
  if (exists("projection_area_file_scenario1") && file.exists(projection_area_file_scenario1)) {
    df_s1_raw <- readxl::read_excel(projection_area_file_scenario1)
    if (is.character(df_s1_raw[[1]]) || is.factor(df_s1_raw[[1]])) {
      area_matrix_scenario1 <- as.matrix(df_s1_raw[, -1])
    } else {
      area_matrix_scenario1 <- as.matrix(df_s1_raw)
    }
  } else {
    area_matrix_scenario1 <- area_matrix_bau
  }
}
area_matrix_scenario1 <- as.matrix(area_matrix_scenario1)
storage.mode(area_matrix_scenario1) <- "numeric"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. EKSTRAK VEKTOR DARI gdp_baseline & FILTER SEKTOR DUMMY (X_0 = 0)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sektor_names <- as.character(unlist(gdp_baseline$SECTOR))
Y_0          <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$FD));          names(Y_0)    <- sektor_names
x_0          <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$OUTPUT));      names(x_0)    <- sektor_names
v_0          <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$GDP));         names(v_0)    <- sektor_names
Land_0       <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$Land_Requirement))
LPC_0        <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$LPC))

Z            <- as.matrix(baseline$intermediate_consumption)
storage.mode(Z) <- "numeric"
rownames(Z)  <- colnames(Z) <- sektor_names

# Filter sektor valid (Output > 0)
idx_valid    <- which(x_0 > 0)

Z            <- Z[idx_valid, idx_valid, drop = FALSE]
x_0          <- x_0[idx_valid]
Y_0          <- Y_0[idx_valid]
v_0          <- v_0[idx_valid]
Land_0       <- Land_0[idx_valid]
LPC_0        <- LPC_0[idx_valid]
sektor_names <- sektor_names[idx_valid]
n            <- length(idx_valid)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. EKSTRAKSI KOEFISIEN INPUT PRIMER LANGSUNG (KOREKSI BENAR)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A. Koefisien Proporsi PDRB / GDP (v_c)
v_c <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$GDP_PROP))[idx_valid]

# B. Koefisien Pendapatan Tenaga Kerja Langsung (w_c)
# (Kompensasi Gaji & Upah Nominal / Output Baseline)
w_c <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$labour_multiplier$Labour_Compensation))[idx_valid] / x_0

# C. Koefisien Serapan Tenaga Kerja Langsung (l_c)
# (Jumlah Fisik Tenaga Kerja [Jiwa] / Output Baseline) -> Satuan: Orang / Juta Rp
l_c <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$labour_multiplier$Labour))[idx_valid] / x_0

# D. Koefisien Surplus Usaha Bruto Langsung (sub_c)
# (Nilai Surplus Usaha Nominal / Output Baseline)
sub_c <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$SUB_multiplier$Surplus))[idx_valid] / x_0
  
# Remap index sektor terkendala/constrained (co) dan unconstrained (no)
co_idx <- which(idx_valid %in% which(constrained == 1))
no_idx <- which(idx_valid %in% which(unconstrained == 1))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. REKLASIFIKASI SEKTOR TERKENDALA (L=0 ATAU LPC=0 DIPINDAHKAN KE nc)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
mask_bermasalah <- (Land_0[co_idx] <= 0) | (LPC_0[co_idx] <= 0)

if (any(mask_bermasalah)) {
  co_idx_pindah <- co_idx[mask_bermasalah]
  co_idx        <- co_idx[!mask_bermasalah]
  no_idx        <- sort(c(no_idx, co_idx_pindah))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. FORMULASI MATRIKS LEONTIEF & INDEKS KETERKAITAN (ITBL & ITFL)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A_full <- sweep(Z, 2, x_0, "/")
M_full <- diag(n) - A_full
B_full <- solve(M_full) # Invers Leontief Penuh (I - A)^(-1)

col_sum_B   <- colSums(B_full)
row_sum_B   <- rowSums(B_full)
total_sum_B <- sum(B_full)

ITBL_vector <- (n * col_sum_B) / total_sum_B
ITFL_vector <- (n * row_sum_B) / total_sum_B

idx_co      <- co_idx
idx_nc      <- no_idx
p_0_co      <- as.numeric(LPC_0[idx_co])

M_nc_co     <- M_full[idx_nc, idx_co, drop = FALSE]
M_nc_nc     <- M_full[idx_nc, idx_nc, drop = FALSE]
M_nc_nc_inv <- solve(M_nc_nc)

tahun        <- as.numeric(colnames(area_matrix_bau))
t_max        <- length(tahun)
initial_year <- if (exists("params") && !is.null(params$initial_year)) params$initial_year else 2025


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. FUNGSI ITERASI PROYEKSI MULTI-INDIKATOR
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
proyeksi_skenario_multi <- function(area_matrix, P_matrix, Y_0, idx_co, idx_nc,
                                    p_0_co, M_nc_co, M_nc_nc_inv, v_c, w_c, l_c, sub_c,
                                    growth_rate, initial_year, tahun) {
  t_max <- length(tahun)
  n     <- length(v_c)
  m     <- length(idx_co)

  x_out             <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  PDRB_sektoral     <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  Inc_sektoral      <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  Lab_sektoral      <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  SUB_sektoral      <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  L_co_matrix       <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = m)

  # P_matrix: [n_sektor × n_tutupan] = [61 × 73]
  # Ambil baris idx_co → [n_co × n_tutupan]
  P_sub <- as.matrix(P_matrix[idx_co, , drop = FALSE])   # ← BARIS
  storage.mode(P_sub) <- "numeric"

  for (k in seq_len(t_max)) {
    yr             <- tahun[k]
    selisih_tahun  <- yr - initial_year

    # A. Permintaan akhir nc
    Y_nc_t <- Y_0[idx_nc] * ((1 + growth_rate[idx_nc]) ^ selisih_tahun)

    # B. Output sektor co dibatasi lahan
    luas_tutupan_t <- as.numeric(unlist(area_matrix[, k]))   # [n_tutupan] = [73]
    # P_sub: [n_co × 73] %*% luas: [73] = [n_co]
    L_co_t         <- as.vector(P_sub %*% luas_tutupan_t)    # [n_co]
    x_co_t         <- matrix(L_co_t * p_0_co, ncol = 1)

    # C. Mixed IO
    rhs    <- Y_nc_t - (M_nc_co %*% x_co_t)
    x_nc_t <- M_nc_nc_inv %*% rhs

    # D. Rekonstruksi
    x_t             <- numeric(n)
    x_t[idx_co]     <- as.vector(x_co_t)
    x_t[idx_nc]     <- as.vector(x_nc_t)

    # E. Multi-indikator
    PDRB_sektoral[k, ] <- v_c * x_t
    Inc_sektoral[k, ]  <- w_c * x_t
    Lab_sektoral[k, ]  <- l_c * x_t
    SUB_sektoral[k, ]  <- sub_c * x_t
    x_out[k, ]         <- x_t
    L_co_matrix[k, ]   <- L_co_t
  }

  list(
    x_t           = x_out,
    L_co_matrix   = L_co_matrix,
    PDRB_total    = rowSums(PDRB_sektoral),
    Inc_total     = rowSums(Inc_sektoral),
    Lab_total     = rowSums(Lab_sektoral),
    SUB_total     = rowSums(SUB_sektoral),
    Output_total  = rowSums(x_out)
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. JALANKAN SIMULASI: BAU VS SKENARIO 1
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
proyeksi_bau <- proyeksi_skenario_multi(
  area_matrix = area_matrix_bau, P_matrix = P_default,
  Y_0 = Y_0, idx_co = idx_co, idx_nc = idx_nc, p_0_co = p_0_co,
  M_nc_co = M_nc_co, M_nc_nc_inv = M_nc_nc_inv,
  v_c = v_c, w_c = w_c, l_c = l_c, sub_c = sub_c,
  growth_rate = growth_rate, initial_year = initial_year, tahun = tahun
)

proyeksi_s1 <- proyeksi_skenario_multi(
  area_matrix = area_matrix_scenario1, P_matrix = P_default_scenario1,
  Y_0 = Y_0, idx_co = idx_co, idx_nc = idx_nc, p_0_co = p_0_co,
  M_nc_co = M_nc_co, M_nc_nc_inv = M_nc_nc_inv,
  v_c = v_c, w_c = w_c, l_c = l_c, sub_c = sub_c,
  growth_rate = growth_rate, initial_year = initial_year, tahun = tahun
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. REKAPITULASI PROYEKSI MAKROEKONOMI KOMPARATIF
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_proyeksi_multi <- data.frame(
  Tahun                  = tahun,

  PDRB_BAU_Juta          = proyeksi_bau$PDRB_total,
  PDRB_S1_Juta           = proyeksi_s1$PDRB_total,
  PDRB_Dampak_Pct        = (proyeksi_s1$PDRB_total - proyeksi_bau$PDRB_total) / proyeksi_bau$PDRB_total * 100,

  Pendapatan_BAU_Juta    = proyeksi_bau$Inc_total,
  Pendapatan_S1_Juta     = proyeksi_s1$Inc_total,
  Pendapatan_Dampak_Pct  = (proyeksi_s1$Inc_total - proyeksi_bau$Inc_total) / proyeksi_bau$Inc_total * 100,

  TenagaKerja_BAU_Orang  = proyeksi_bau$Lab_total,
  TenagaKerja_S1_Orang   = proyeksi_s1$Lab_total,
  TenagaKerja_Dampak_Pct = (proyeksi_s1$Lab_total - proyeksi_bau$Lab_total) / proyeksi_bau$Lab_total * 100,

  SUB_BAU_Juta           = proyeksi_bau$SUB_total,
  SUB_S1_Juta            = proyeksi_s1$SUB_total,
  SUB_Dampak_Pct         = (proyeksi_s1$SUB_total - proyeksi_bau$SUB_total) / proyeksi_bau$SUB_total * 100
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. REKAPITULASI ITBL & ITFL SEKTOR LAHAN PER TAHUN
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_keterkaitan_lahan <- data.frame()

for (k in seq_len(t_max)) {
  yr <- tahun[k]
  df_temp <- data.frame(
    Tahun         = yr,
    Sektor_Lahan  = sektor_names[idx_co],
    Luas_BAU_ha   = proyeksi_bau$L_co_matrix[k, ],
    Luas_S1_ha    = proyeksi_s1$L_co_matrix[k, ],
    Selisih_ha    = proyeksi_s1$L_co_matrix[k, ] - proyeksi_bau$L_co_matrix[k, ],
    ITBL          = round(ITBL_vector[idx_co], 4),
    ITFL          = round(ITFL_vector[idx_co], 4)
  )
  df_keterkaitan_lahan <- rbind(df_keterkaitan_lahan, df_temp)
}
```

```{r visualisasi-komparatif-multi-indikator, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# 10. VISUALISASI KOMPARATIF MULTI-INDIKATOR: 5 TABEL & 5 GRAFIK (ABSOLUT)
#     BAU VS SKENARIO 1
# ==============================================================================

# --- Helper: Grouped Bar Chart Komparasi Total ---
plot_komparasi_total <- function(df, var_bau, var_s1, title_text, y_label, scale_factor = 1) {
  df_plot <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Tahun, BAU = all_of(var_bau), Skenario_1 = all_of(var_s1)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      BAU        = BAU / scale_factor,
      Skenario_1 = Skenario_1 / scale_factor
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c("BAU", "Skenario_1"),
      names_to = "Skenario",
      values_to = "Nilai"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Skenario = dplyr::recode(Skenario, "Skenario_1" = "Skenario 1"))

  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = factor(Tahun), y = Nilai, fill = Skenario)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("BAU" = "#7f7f7f", "Skenario 1" = "#1f77b4")) +
    labs(
      title    = title_text,
      subtitle = "Perbandingan Nilai Total Absolut: BAU vs Skenario 1",
      x        = "Tahun Proyeksi",
      y        = y_label,
      fill     = "Skenario"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

# --- Helper: Tabel Komparasi DT ---
tabel_komparasi_dt <- function(df, col_bau, col_s1, caption_text, unit_label, scale_factor = 1, digits = 2) {
  df_dt <- df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Tahun                = Tahun,
      `BAU`                = round(.data[[col_bau]] / scale_factor, digits),
      `Skenario 1`         = round(.data[[col_s1]] / scale_factor, digits),
      `Selisih (S1 - BAU)` = round((.data[[col_s1]] - .data[[col_bau]]) / scale_factor, digits)
    )

  DT::datatable(
    df_dt,
    caption = paste0(caption_text, " (", unit_label, ")"),
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 5, dom = 'tip')
  ) %>%
    DT::formatCurrency(c("BAU", "Skenario 1", "Selisih (S1 - BAU)"),
                       currency = "", interval = 3, mark = ",", digits = digits)
}

# ==============================================================================
# INDIKATOR 1: PDRB / GDP TOTAL  (TIDAK BERUBAH)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\n### 1. Proyeksi PDRB Total (Triliun Rupiah)\n")

tabel_komparasi_dt(
  df = df_proyeksi_multi,
  col_bau = "PDRB_BAU_Juta",
  col_s1  = "PDRB_S1_Juta",
  caption_text = "Tabel 1: Proyeksi Total PDRB / GDP",
  unit_label   = "Triliun Rp",
  scale_factor = 1e6,
  digits       = 2
)

p1_pdrb <- plot_komparasi_total(
  df = df_proyeksi_multi,
  var_bau = "PDRB_BAU_Juta",
  var_s1  = "PDRB_S1_Juta",
  title_text = "1. Proyeksi PDRB Total (Triliun Rupiah)",
  y_label    = "Total PDRB (Triliun Rp)",
  scale_factor = 1e6
)
print(p1_pdrb)

# ==============================================================================
# INDIKATOR 2: PENDAPATAN TENAGA KERJA TOTAL  →  JUta Rupiah
# ==============================================================================

# INDIKATOR 5: TOTAL LUAS LAHAN SEKTOR TERKENDALA & KETERKAITAN (ITBL/ITFL)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\n### 5. Proyeksi Total Luas Lahan Sektor Terkendala & Indeks Keterkaitan (ITBL/ITFL)\n")

df_lahan_total <- df_keterkaitan_lahan %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Tahun) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Total_Luas_BAU_ha = sum(Luas_BAU_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Luas_S1_ha  = sum(Luas_S1_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

DT::datatable(
  df_keterkaitan_lahan,
  caption = "Tabel 5: Detail Luas Lahan Sektoral (Hektar) dan Indeks Keterkaitan (ITBL & ITFL)",
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(pageLength = 6)
) %>%
  DT::formatRound(c("Luas_BAU_ha", "Luas_S1_ha", "Selisih_ha", "ITBL", "ITFL"), digits = 2)

p5_lahan <- plot_komparasi_total(
  df = df_lahan_total,
  var_bau = "Total_Luas_BAU_ha",
  var_s1  = "Total_Luas_S1_ha",
  title_text = "5. Proyeksi Total Luas Lahan Sektor Terkendala (Hektar)",
  y_label    = "Total Luas Lahan (Hektar)",
  scale_factor = 1
)
print(p5_lahan)
```
